# MySentry

> MySentry is a Safety and Health monitoring app with Emergency Response. It provides panic alarm, fall detection, crash detection, health alerts (HRV, SpO2, heart rate), emergency contacts, live video response, and 24/7 professional monitoring. Available on iOS and Android with Apple Watch and Samsung Watch support.

## Key Facts

- Pricing starts at $14.99/month for individuals, $24.99/month for families
- 7-day free trial available
- Works with iPhone, Android, Apple Watch, Samsung Watch
- 24/7 professional monitoring by certified agents
- Fall detection uses phone and smartwatch accelerometer and gyroscope sensors
- Crash detection uses phone GPS speed data combined with accelerometer impact patterns
- Health monitoring tracks heart rate, HRV, SpO2, and skin temperature via smartwatch
- Live video response allows monitoring agents to see the scene during an emergency
- Emergency contacts receive SMS, push notification, and email alerts with GPS location
- MeetSafe check-ins provide timed safety timers for meetings and appointments
